title: Bind the named-project scope token to local resolution or a not-resolvable error
description:
Bind the addressing core's named-project scope token to project identity so a `@<project>` address distinguishes the local project (which resolves) from any other named project (which is syntactically valid but not resolvable locally), per this epic's REQ-09 and design decision D5. This item adds no path parsing of its own and builds no federation or remote lookup — only the local-vs-other resolution binding.

By the time this task runs, prerequisite addressing-core work has extended `Scope` (`crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:89-152`) with a `Scope::NamedProject(String)` variant and taught the structural parser to produce it for any `@<name>` segment, without consulting any declared project identity. This task consumes that variant; it does not add a `Scope` variant of its own, does not modify the structural parse, and does not fold a local-name comparison into parse time.

What to build, in `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs`:
- A resolution-facing pure function (or method on `Scope`) that takes the declared local project name as a plain `&str` (the caller supplies the already-loaded config value — this keeps the function pure domain code with no file I/O, per this project's layering rule that domain logic must be free of I/O) and binds the scope token:
  - `Scope::Project` (bare `@`) resolves as the local project, unchanged from today.
  - `Scope::NamedProject(name)` where `name` equals the supplied local project name resolves identically to `Scope::Project`.
  - `Scope::NamedProject(name)` where `name` differs returns a clear not-resolvable error.
- A new `ItemError` variant (`crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:245-355` shows the existing `thiserror` enum pattern to follow), e.g. `ItemError::NotResolvable { project: String }`, with an `#[error(...)]` message that names the unresolvable project and states plainly that resolution is local-only and no federation or remote lookup was attempted.
- `Scope::Issue` passes through the binding unchanged (issue scopes carry no project identity).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: unit tests in `domain/item.rs` prove that, given a supplied local project name (e.g. `"acme"`), the binding resolves both `Scope::Project` (bare `@`) and `Scope::NamedProject("acme")` as the local project, consuming the structurally parsed scope token rather than re-parsing or re-implementing any `@`-prefix matching.
- [hard] REQ-02: a unit test proves the binding maps `Scope::NamedProject("other-project")` (local name `"acme"`) to `Err(ItemError::NotResolvable { project })`, with a `to_string()` message that contains `"other-project"` and states resolution is local-only with no network or remote attempt.
